verdict.rationale: DBOS ships an official MCP server (dbos-mcp / DBOS Conductor MCP) documented at docs.dbos.dev/integrations/mcp for augmenting LLMs/agents with tools to manage DBOS workflows, and a runtime probe confirms a full keyless stdio initialize handshake succeeded against the real server. Missing for 10: independent community usage reports specifically about the MCP server (only docs/probe evidence, no third-party hands-on review).
